name: Field journal
description: An editorial journal with a masthead, a front page of one lead story, four smaller stories and an archive, and an article view with a post-town rail, margin notes, brush annotations, a pull quote and an image pair.

props.name: images
props.description: Pictures by slot: the five story images, the two halves of the article's image pair and the four archive covers. A missing picture shows a quiet placeholder.

props.name: avatars
props.description: Portraits keyed by author name, used in bylines. Anyone without one shows initials.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Which view opens first: the front page, or the lead story as an article.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at least the height of the viewport and the page scrolls. Also accepts every other div attribute.
